sources.summary: Arched openings and rough brick walls evoke the feel of a Roman bathhouse at Alchemy Saunas, a wellness centre in Australia by interior design studio Rezen. The project involved transforming a former stable and cellar at the base of the Royal George Hotel in Fremantle, which dates back to 1903 and is currently undergoing redevelopment. The post Rezen transforms hotel stables in Australia into "raw and direct" wellness centre appeared first on Dezeen .
